help.text:
Usage: subjack [options]

Options:
  -a	Send requests to every URL, not just those with identified CNAMEs.
  -ar
    	Check for stale A records pointing to dead IPs (may require root for ICMP).
  -axfr
    	Check for zone transfers (AXFR) including NS bruteforce.
  -d string
    	Single domain to check.
  -m	Flag dead CNAME records even if the domain is not available for registration.
  -mail
    	Check for SPF include and MX record takeovers.
  -ns
    	Check if nameservers are available for purchase (NS takeover).
  -o string
    	Output results to file (use .json extension for JSON output).
  -r string
    	Path to a list of DNS resolvers.
  -ssl
    	Force HTTPS connections (may increase accuracy).
  -t int
    	Number of concurrent threads. (default 10)
  -timeout int
    	Seconds to wait before connection timeout. (default 10)
  -v	Display more information per request.
  -w string
    	Path to wordlist.

--a.help: Send requests to every URL, not just those with identified CNAMEs.

--ar.help: Check for stale A records pointing to dead IPs (may require root for ICMP).

--axfr.help: Check for zone transfers (AXFR) including NS bruteforce.

--https.help: Force HTTPS connections (May increase accuracy. Default: http://).

--m.help: Flag dead CNAME records even if the domain is not available for registration.

--mail.help: Check for SPF include and MX record takeovers.

--ns.help: Check if nameservers are available for purchase (NS takeover).

--o.help: Output results to file (use .json extension for JSON output).

--r.help: Path to a list of DNS resolvers.

--save.help: Output file to write subdomains saved with amass to.

--strict.help: Find those hidden gems by sending HTTP requests to ever URL. (Default: HTTP requests are only sent to URLs with cloud CNAMEs).

--timeout.help: Seconds to wait before connection timeout.

-ar.help: Check for stale A records pointing to dead IPs (may require root for ICMP).

-axfr.help: Check for zone transfers (AXFR) including NS bruteforce.

-mail.help: Check for SPF include and MX record takeovers.

-ns.help: Check if nameservers are available for purchase (NS takeover).

-o.help: Output results to file (use .json extension for JSON output).

-r.help: Path to a list of DNS resolvers.

-timeout.help: Seconds to wait before connection timeout. (default 10)
